审查当前项目的固定成本、现金储备和信用风险，明确可承受的风险边界。
建立经营决策日志，持续记录机会判断、行动结果和可复用经验。

knowledgePoints: 创业机会不仅来自直接需求，也可从产业增长必然带来的配套需求中寻找。

comment.text: It's crazy to think I started listening to your podcast about 4–5 years ago. Fast forward to today, I own a business, make a living from it, and still use many of the ideas and mental models from the books you've covered. Your work has had a real impact on how I think about building a company. Thanks for putting it all out there.
